entities.summary: Janusz Czesław Wojciechowski is a Polish politician of Law and Justice who served as European Commissioner for Agriculture in the Von der Leyen Commission I from 2019 to 2024. He previously served as Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 2004 to 2016 and as the Polish member of the European Court of Auditors from 2016 to 2019.
